title: convolvulus neei
intro: Convolvulus neei, commonly known as the 'Desert Holly', is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent and the Middle East. This plant has been traditionally used to treat a range of health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating infections. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus neei include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Convolvulus neei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
